title: Broken Watchface with patched/Nfc enabled Sony watch
symptom: After patching a Sony SmartWatch 3 to enable NFC for reading a Libre CGM, the xDrip+ watchface stopped working: it stays empty, receives no data, sometimes no time or battery status. Newer xDrip+ versions also cause xdrip-prefs to crash when changing settings. An older version from June 2017 works.
cause: The watchface issue is likely due to outdated Google Play services on the watch (requires version 9.x, found 7.8.9). The xdrip-prefs crash is the same as issue #167 and is fixed in the Sept 8th nightly.
fix: Update Google Play services on the watch to version 9.8.41 by installing the APK with 'adb install -r' (to upgrade). Also install the latest nightly build of xDrip+ to fix the prefs crash.
evidence_quote: Wuhu, seems to work now. Had to install the 9.8.41 version of play services. Older versions got me crashes and atempts to update, newer version i got error messages "old sdk" while installation. Watchface works now with the newest nightly build of xdrip+, also the syncing between watch and phone.
